escalation.definition: Taking a matter to a more senior person because it has not moved. Use it only when it is genuinely warranted.
escalation.example: If we do not hear back by Friday, we will need to escalate this.

opener.definition: The first thing you say to start a conversation. It should be easy for the other person to answer.
opener.example: My usual opener at a party is a question about what brought them there.
